function: Joint device activity detection and channel estimation (JADCE) of sparse uplink channels from non-orthogonal pilots in grant-free mMTC; channel NMSE is the main metric (p. 9).
system: Single-cell uplink mMTC, N=200 single-antenna devices, BS with M=1 (SMV) or M=4 (MMV) antennas, uncorrelated block fading; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 3, p. 9, p. 10).
method: Deep-unfolded PC-ADMM as complex-valued network, K=20 layers, with LSTM-based channel attention replacing the proximal operator; supervised training with Adam against ground-truth channels (p. 8, p. 9).
data_channel: Synthetic: complex-Gaussian CN(0, kappa_n) block-fading channels, spatially uncorrelated; Gaussian pilots CN(0,1); 10^4 training, 1000 validation, 1000 test samples of Y=AX+E; no 3GPP or measured data (p. 3, p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained over random SNR 5-25 dB and access probability 0.05-0.2 (p. 9); tested with sweeps of SNR, pilot length, access probability, antennas M (p. 10, p. 11).
baselines: Classical: ADMM, IRW-ADMM. Learned: ISTA-Net, ADMM-Net (deep unfolding, real-valued); also PC-ADMM-RVNN real-valued variant and plain PC-ADMM (p. 9).
metrics: Channel NMSE; activity detection probability Pd versus false alarm probability Pf (ROC); convergence versus iterations/layers (p. 9, p. 10, p. 11).
complexity: Complexity per layer O(N^2+LNM) and 58N^2+33N+2K trainable parameters; Table II compares ADMM O(N^2 M), ISTA-Net O(LNM), ADMM-Net O(N^2(N+M)) (p. 8, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 3: "static block spatially uncorrelated fading channel" with h_n ~ CN(0, kappa_n); custom synthetic simulator, no 3GPP model and no measured data mentioned.
q2_support: p. 9: "randomly distributed across SNR values spanning [5, 25] dB and access probabilities spanning [0.05, 0.2]"; p. 10: "with various SNRs, pilot lengths, and access probabilities"; only sweeps, training L and M never stated.
q3_support: p. 9: "ADMM [18], which is the classical ADMM"; p. 9: "ISTA-Net [24], [25], a deep unfolding network"; p. 11: "the PC-ADMM-CVNN has the best recovery performance"
q4_support: p. 8: "we can conclude the overall complexity of PC-ADMM-CVNN is" O(N^2+LNM); parameters 58N^2+33N+2K; Table II on p. 9 compares baselines.
q5_support: p. 9: "through the system model Y = AX + E"; data are synthetic and generated by the authors; no code or data link and no public dataset is mentioned.
notes: JADCE counted as channel estimation (area 2) because the first metric is channel NMSE (p. 9), with ROC for activity detection (p. 11). BS has M=4 antennas in the main MMV runs (p. 10), so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. PC-ADMM-RVNN is a variant of the proposed method and was not counted as a learned baseline. The L=30 to 70 and M=1 to 16 sweeps (p. 11) might be new conditions, but the paper never says training used another L or M, so q2 is 0.
